Method of Attack: Exploits patched bugs in Internet Explorer (CVE-2018-8174) and Adobe Flash (CVE-2018-15982, CVE-2018-4878) to deliver banking trojans
Uses a traffic directing system (TDS) to redirect victims to landing and exploit pages
Drive-by attack via compromised B2B website
Drops banking trojans IceD and Dridex
Attack Vector: Browser-based exploit kit leveraging vulnerable software
Indicators of Compromise: Redirects to exploit kit landing pages and final redirect to Google search page
